text:
sophie: Hey team — incoming customer request from Acme Health to onboard Athena-19B on hosted. They want FP4 quant + fallback to int8, latency SLO ~120ms @512 tokens, EU data residency, and a pilot next week. Can we triage?

maria: @sophie got it. Do we have model artifacts & config? any tokenizer details?

sophie: they uploaded links: gs://acme/athena-19b/v1/safetensors and gs://acme/athena-19b/v1/config.json. Model file ~38GB, dense autoregressive, vocab ~50k. Asked for cost/latency estimate + quant plan.

arjun: I can spin a eu-west1 staging node for smoke. Prefer safetensors -> gguf conversion first. @sophie can you confirm format?

sophie: confirmed safetensors. Sharing quick convert command they suggested:
```bash
python convert.py --input Athena-19b.safetensors --output athena-19b.gguf --dtype fp16
```

kai: Ops note — hosted staging has limited instances this week. If the pilot needs sustained capacity we should flag for Dedicated. For now canary is fine. :thumbsup:

maria: Plan proposal: (1) run two quant recipes: int8 + fp4; (2) calibration & eval on 100-sample medical prompt set; (3) measure p50/p95 latency at 128/512 tokens; (4) check quality regressions vs baseline (delta <=5% accept). I'll own accuracy runs.

sophie: sent eval prompts (ehr-summaries-100.txt) to the shared bucket. Also added a couple of edge-case prompts (redactions, long context).

eval-bot: quick smoke results (auto): int8 -> throughput x2.2 but F1 on medical Q drops 7.3%. fp4 -> throughput x1.9, F1 delta +1.1% (within noise). Latency p95 at 512 tokens:
- fp16 baseline: 110ms
- int8: 65ms
- fp4: 72ms

maria: Interesting — preliminary fp4 seems promising on quality. Next steps: full eval run (1k prompts) + safety checks. If fp4 holds, we recommend fp4 for hosted canary.
arjun: Creating infra ticket INF-1243 to provision eu-west staging GPU and disk. ETA 48-72h. I'll attach conversion and run instructions.
sophie: tagging @maria @arjun @kai — marking as P2 (customer pilot schedule). If we hit quality regression in int8 we will not promote. Thanks team. :rocket:
